cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_date_time_worker C CXX)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable worker fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
option(CUI_DATETIME_BUILD_STYLED "Include optional Styled facade" ON)
target_sources(cui PRIVATE "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/src/base/cui_date_time_picker.c")
if(CUI_DATETIME_BUILD_STYLED)
 target_sources(cui PRIVATE "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/src/components/cui_date_time_picker.c")
endif()
add_executable(test_date_time_picker "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_date_time_picker.c")
target_link_libraries(test_date_time_picker PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(test_date_time_picker)
add_test(NAME date_time_picker COMMAND test_date_time_picker)
add_library(date_time_header OBJECT header.cpp)
target_link_libraries(date_time_header PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(date_time_header)
set_property(TARGET date_time_header PROPERTY CXX_STANDARD 11)

if(CUI_DATETIME_BUILD_STYLED)
add_executable(test_date_time_picker_styled "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_date_time_picker_styled.c")
target_link_libraries(test_date_time_picker_styled PRIVATE cui cui_software)
cui_warnings(test_date_time_picker_styled)
add_test(NAME date_time_picker_styled COMMAND test_date_time_picker_styled)

set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/DATE_TIME_PICKER.md")
file(READ "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/DATE_TIME_PICKER.md" guide)
string(REGEX MATCH "<!-- datetime-example-begin -->[\n]```c[\n](.*)[\n]```[\n]<!-- datetime-example-end -->" example "${guide}")
if(NOT example)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing guide example")
endif()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/guide.c" "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/guide.cpp" "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
add_library(datetime_guide OBJECT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/guide.c" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/guide.cpp")
target_link_libraries(datetime_guide PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(datetime_guide)
set_property(TARGET datetime_guide PROPERTY CXX_STANDARD 11)
endif()
